description:
List this account's broadcasts with their status. A broadcast is a public link where listeners follow a live transcription in their own language.
Use: to find a broadcastId, or see which are on air right now. For one broadcast's recorded transcriptions and streams, call get_broadcast with its id; for what was said, get_transcription with a transcriptionId (broadcasts' recordings are also in list_transcriptions).
Arguments: lifecycle only, and it is optional: active (the default) for broadcasts in use, archived for those in the trash (deleted within the restore window, restorable with update_broadcast restore true), all for both. Examples: {} lists the active ones; {lifecycle: "archived"} shows what can still be restored.
Behaviour: free and read-only; most recently updated first, up to 500 per lifecycle in one call, with no paging: with more than 500 in that lifecycle, the 500 most recently updated come back, and an older one is still reachable by id with get_broadcast. rate_limited (with retryAfterS) past 600 calls a minute per API key.
Returns: broadcasts (broadcastId, name, link, access, onAir, listenersNow, lastRecordedAt once it has recorded, archived for one in the trash; while on air transcriptionId, state, onAirSince). None: an empty list.
Errors: invalid_options for an unknown lifecycle.

lifecycle.description: Which broadcasts: active those in use, archived those in the trash, all both.
